title: Software Engineer - Mobile (iOS/Android) Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Software Engineer - Mobile (iOS/Android).

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Entry-level / New Grad: Mobile app lifecycle, UI layout primitives, memory awareness, and asynchronous network calls.
2. Mid-level: State architecture (MVVM, MVI, Redux), local caching (SQLite, Room, CoreData), offline sync, background task scheduling, and push notifications.
3. Senior: Mobile performance (app launch time, memory leaks, frame drops 60/120fps, battery drain), modular app architecture, CI/CD release automation, and crash reporting.
4. Staff-plus: Cross-platform mobile strategy, mobile core infrastructure (networking layers, design systems), and app store release risk governance.

sections.heading: Question Strategy & Guidance
lines: - PREFER BRIEF PILLARS: Explore the candidate's mobile projects, target OS experience (Swift/Kotlin/React Native/Flutter), and app architecture.
- Focus on constraints unique to mobile: intermittent connectivity, limited battery, background execution limits, and OS version fragmentation.
